_note: Local-government debt ceilings (地方政府债务限额) approved by the NPC, 亿元 RMB. Each March the NPC approves the year's general and special ceilings in the budget report; the ceiling is for the full calendar year, so it applies from January (before the March session the previous year's ceiling formally carries, but the monitor follows the NPC convention of a full-year ceiling). One intra-year change: on 2024-11-08 the NPC Standing Committee approved 60,000亿元 of extra special-debt ceiling for swapping hidden debt, booked into the 2024 ceiling in a single approval (一次报批、分三年实施). 'total' = gen + spec. MOF's monthly 地方政府债券发行和债务余额情况 restates the ceiling in most months; build_monitor.py checks those restatements against this file.
